latest_release.name: IReader v2.0.27
latest_release.body:
## 🎉 IReader v2.0.27 ### 📦 What's New - feat(i18n): Update Chinese translations for similar titles (#270) (@Lana0741) - feat(i18n): migrate hardcoded UI strings in More Screen (#279) (@Lana0741) - fix: accept object init in the URLSearchParams JS polyfill (#285) (@LautaBett) - chore: update dependencies and improve theme error handling (@kazemcodes) - Refactor translation and TTS services, improve regex handling, and enhance backup import functionality (@kazemcodes) - feat(build): enhance APK size reduction and configure Zip tasks for Zip64 support (@kazemcodes) - feat: add GitHub Actions workflow for publishing source API and update package version handling (@kazemcodes) - feat: add Kotlin Multiplatform plugin support and update package version in source-api (@kazemcodes) - fix: remove unused iOS build result from GitHub Actions script and clean up test summary (@kazemcodes) - ci: Remove PR comment step from Check workflow (@kazemcodes) - fix(extensions): don't crash when an extension fails to load (#290) (@database4k) - feat: add local network permission handling for Android 17+ and implement rationale dialog (@kazemcodes) - fix(tts): keep bracketed text, resume from headset, save chapter progress (#287) (@database4k) - feat(tts): tapping a paragraph scrolls it to the top (#292) (@database4k) - feat(search): respect source languages; search likely hits first (#293) (@database4k) - fix(tts): don't stall on "..."; keep TTS chapter progress after the reader closes (#296) (@database4k) - fix(epub): don't repeat the chapter title; keep
lines in one paragraph (#297) (@database4k) - fix(epub): keep paragraph breaks and real text on export (#288) (@database4k) - fix(search): global search uses the source's own search filters (#289) (@database4k) - fix(backup, reader): restore keeps history; whitespace-tolerant replacements (#291) (@database4k) - feat: Enhance security measures and backup configurations (@kazemcodes) - fix(security): update function return syntax for badge management functions (@kazemcodes) - fix(security): enhance security policies and privilege checks for user data (@kazemcodes) - fix(version): update versionName to 2.0.27 and versionCode to 81 for DMG packaging compliance (@kazemcodes) - repalce keys (@kazemcodes) ### 📊 Release Stats - **Commits since last release**: 25 - **Release tag**: `v2.0.27` ### 📥 Downloads Choose the appropriate package for your platform: #### 🤖 Android | Package | Description | |---------|-------------| | `*-arm64-v8a-*.apk` | Modern 64-bit ARM devices (recommended for most phones) | | `*-armeabi-v7a-*.apk` | Older 32-bit ARM devices | | `*-x86_64-*.apk` | 64-bit Intel/AMD (emulators, some tablets) | | `*-x86-*.apk` | 32-bit Intel/AMD devices | #### 🖥️ Desktop | Package | Platform | Notes | |---------|----------|-------| | `.msi` | Windows 10/11 installer | | | `.exe` | Windows portable | No install needed | | `.dmg` | macOS installer | | | `.deb` | Debian/Ubuntu Linux | | | `.rpm` | Fedora/RHEL Linux | | | `.tar.gz` | Universal Linux (any distro) | Extract and run | | `.jar` | Cross-platform (requires Java 21+) | | ### 🔗 Links - **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/IReaderorg/IReader/compare/v2.0.26-patch2...v2.0.27 - **Website**: https://ireaderorg.netlify.app/ - **Documentation**: https://github.com/ireaderorg/ireader/wiki - **Report Issues**: https://github.com/ireaderorg/ireader/issues ### 📝 Installation Notes
Android 1. Download the APK matching your device architecture 2. Enable "Install from Unknown Sources" in Settings > Security 3. Open the downloaded APK to install
Windows 1. Download the `.msi` installer or `.exe` portable 2. Run the installer (you may need to allow it through SmartScreen) 3. Follow the installation wizard - Or use the `.exe` portable version (no install needed)
